name.ja: Figure-rise Mechanics Dr.スランプ アラレちゃん

description.ja: ロボットを内部メカから組み立てることができるFigure-rise MechanicsにDr.スランプ アラレちゃんから「則巻アラレ」が登場！
description.en: "Arale Norimaki" from Dr. Slump Arale-chan appears in Figure-rise Mechanics, which can assemble robots from internal mechanisms!

description.ja: • 作中に登場の「アラレちゃんの構造がすべて分かるX線写真」をもとにアラレちゃんの内部メカを忠実再現！組み立てていくことで、アラレちゃんの内部メカが理解でき、よりアラレちゃんを知ることができます！
description.en: • Arale-chan's internal mechanism is faithfully reproduced based on the "X-ray photograph that shows all of Arale-chan's structure" that appears in the work! By assembling, you can understand Arale-chan's internal mechanism and get to know Arale-chan better!

description.ja: • 内部メカには可動ギミックを搭載。「んちゃ砲」の発動再現や、お腹の内部メカの可動でアラレちゃんのお腹の中を覗くことが可能です！
description.en: • The internal mechanism is equipped with a movable gimmick. You can see inside Arale-chan's stomach by reproducing the activation of the "Ncha Cannon" and moving the internal mechanism of her stomach!

description.ja: • 外装パーツには通常色に加え、選択式のスケルトンボディが付属！組み立てた後でも内部メカが見えるディスプレイが楽しめます。
description.en: • In addition to the standard color exterior parts, a selectable skeleton body is included! Enjoy the display that allows you to see the internal mechanism even after assembly.

description.ja: • 付属品には、アラレちゃんの代名詞「んちゃ！」のあいさつ用の手や特徴的な帽子、さらに、うんちくんが付属。
description.en: • Accessories include Arale-chan's signature "ncha!" greeting hand, a distinctive hat, and a poop-kun.

accessories.ja: 差し替手×2（あいさつ手、うんちくん用にぎり手）
accessories.en: Replacement hands x 2 (greeting hands, poop-kun nigiri hands)
